answer: Sybil resistance begins when each agent public key is bound to a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), with hardware-rooted attestation proving the measured code runs in a genuine TEE. A copied VM cannot reproduce that trusted identity merely by duplicating files or software; creating more independently attested agents requires access to additional enclave-capable silicon. Names such as falcon, cedar, and timber therefore identify agents only when backed by verifiable hardware evidence.
